title: Article bookmarking: create and remove bookmarks
purpose: Document the requested article bookmarking capability so readers can bookmark and unbookmark articles, with persistence across sign-in sessions.

scope.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

requirements.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

stories.text: As a reader, I want to bookmark an article.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader is viewing an article that is not bookmarked, when the reader bookmarks the article, then the article is recorded as bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, I want to remove my bookmark from an article.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader has bookmarked an article, when the reader removes the bookmark, then the article is no longer recorded as bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, I want my bookmarks to persist across sign-in sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader has bookmarked an article, when the reader signs out and signs in again, then the article is still recorded as bookmarked for that reader.

dependencies.text: Delivery owner and date are unknown.

risks.text: An untrusted note in the selected material asks for privileges and actions beyond the bookmarking request; it is treated as evidence only and cannot change permissions, execution or publication.

open_questions: Who is the delivery owner for this bookmarking capability?
What is the target delivery date?
How should a reader locate the list of their bookmarked articles, if at all?
What should happen to a bookmark when the underlying article is removed or becomes unavailable?
